text: Assumption: Direct key APIs map cryIfKeyId to driver key IDs in the same way as the job path — is this correct?

norm: direct key apis map cryifkeyid to driver key ids in the same way as the job path
assumption: Direct key APIs map cryIfKeyId to driver key IDs in the same way as the job path.
rationale: SWS_CryIf_00133 only governs this for jobs; the direct APIs receive cryIfKeyId, while the driver functions operate with cryptoKeyId.

original.text: Annahme: Direkte Schlüssel-APIs bilden cryIfKeyId wie der Job-Pfad auf Treiber-Schlüssel-IDs ab — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Direkte Schlüssel-APIs bilden cryIfKeyId wie der Job-Pfad auf Treiber-Schlüssel-IDs ab
original.rationale: SWS_CryIf_00133 regelt dies nur für Jobs; die direkten APIs nehmen cryIfKeyId entgegen, die Treiberfunktionen arbeiten mit cryptoKeyId.
